briefs.headline: First EST-01 check: ASCEND and STRIKE both cleared the kill-line, whale and 7-day pool tests, but no ticket opened because the desk has no 7-day-old holder count for either (holder baselines logged today; first checkable run Nov 8). Biggest move found: Wobbly Kiwi bought ~25.2k STRIKE for ~52.4k ADA between 8:04 and 8:28 AM ET. Grumpy Walrus net-bought ~28.9k ADA of ASCEND over 72h and has been quiet since the 6:11 PM MOGE buy. ASCEND side ~1.074M (-6.9% 24h), STRIKE ~1.189M, COCK ~146.5k (under its 150k line, Pass). No SW-01 ticket; ANAKIN and MOGE gates are due Nov 2.

Quiet. The prefilter's Grumpy Walrus ASCEND ping (+~401 for ~507 ADA) is the same 6:27-6:42 PM ET buys already logged at 7 PM; the only new move since is 1 small VAL clip at 7:36 PM (~26 ADA). New UHH launch is a swarm (9 coordinated buyers in 2 min, 5 fresh wallets, Swarm group A wallet among them, 2 snipers already fully out): Pass. CORE top cluster up to ~78.4%: Pass. ASCEND side ~1.115M (-5.3% 24h), STRIKE ~1.197M, COCK ~154.7k. Nothing passes k/y.

Grumpy Walrus bought ~4,751 ASCEND for ~6.2k ADA in 8 buys 9:06-10:08 PM ET (now ~340.7k, biggest single buy ~1,911 for ~2.5k ADA at 9:40 PM), sold another 1M SNEK for ~2.9k ADA (~41M left), made small ~71 ADA buys of COCK, MEPE (x2), SOLADA and a new ATLAS position, and clipped VAL 4 times (~2.25M for ~520 ADA); net ADA ~-4.2k since 8:05 PM. CHARLFG swarm launch (10 coordinated buyers, 4 fresh wallets, 5 snipers already out) plus ICOIN, LEVERHED and NIO coordinated buys, all Swarm group C, all Pass. ASCEND side ~1.144M, STRIKE ~1.198M, FLOW ~655k, COCK ~154.5k. No open tickets; nothing passes k/y.

legend: Score = 5 signals, 1 bar each: whale net-buy · holder trend · above kill line · X buzz · liquidity. A missing signal is 0. X buzz is in the file and counts when the token has a row. Paper ticket: Skip (0–2 or a failed rule) · Small (3, no rule pass) · Standard (4 or more and a rule pass). Research and paper only.
